description: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy values for two methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four difficulty categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total” in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 (values extend slightly above 60 to accommodate the tallest bars). Each category shows a grouped pair of vertical bars: NatSQL is shown in a light blue bar and TA-SQL in a darker blue bar, with numeric value labels above most bars. For “Simple,” NatSQL is about 60.21 and TA-SQL about 63.14; for “Moderate,” NatSQL is around 40 (with a small gray cap above the light-blue bar) and TA-SQL is labeled 48.60; for “Challenging,” NatSQL is labeled 32.32 and TA-SQL 36.11; and for “Total,” NatSQL is labeled 51.35 and TA-SQL 56.19. The bars are not presented as stacked (aside from the small gray segment atop the Moderate NatSQL bar) and there is no indication that categories are sorted by value; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color legend and the value annotations.
